summary: Backend testing of Twilio voice webhook fax-sound bug fix in /app/backend/voice_routes.py. All 10 pytest cases passed — /api/voice/incoming returns full greeting TwiML (not empty <Response>) on signature failure, callback URLs use https://foreman.drunderhood.com, voicemail rows persist on /voicemail/done, leads with kind='voicemail' are created on /voicemail/transcription (verified via direct mongo inspection), /voice/status returns 204 on signature failure, and GET /api/voicemails returns clean list without _id.
critical_code_review_comments: voice_routes.py inserts into db.calls without unique index on call_sid — the update_one(call_sid) in /voicemail/done may match the first row if multiple insert collisions happen (low risk in prod).

/voice/voicemail/transcription always returns EMPTY_XML (<Response></Response>) — this is fine for an async transcribeCallback (Twilio does not play it back to caller), but worth noting it's an intentional no-op TwiML, distinct from the fax-sound bug on /incoming.

GET /api/voicemails is NOT gated by auth as the original problem statement called out — anyone with the public URL can list voicemails containing caller phone numbers and transcripts. Consider adding user-JWT auth if PII exposure is a concern.

_verify_twilio returns False (not True) when X-Twilio-Signature header is missing, which is correct, but the function never validates that auth_token is non-empty before constructing RequestValidator — already handled with `if not validator` short-circuit. Looks good.
test_credentials: Not required — voice webhooks and /api/voicemails are not auth-gated in current code.
seed_data_creation: Test inserted 2 voicemail rows and 1 lead row (kind=voicemail, source=voicemail) into the shared mongo db via the public endpoints — these remain as TEST_ prefixed call_sids (CA_TEST_VM_..., CA_TEST_TR_...). Not cleaned up; consider a teardown if rerun frequency is high.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Voice webhook fix verified end-to-end. Test file /app/backend/tests/test_voice_routes.py is the regression suite — re-run with `pytest backend/tests/test_voice_routes.py -v`. Note TWILIO_AUTH_TOKEN must remain set in /app/backend/.env for the tests to exercise the signature-failure path (which is the fix being verified). If env changes to empty, _verify_twilio short-circuits to True and the tests still pass but no longer test the fax-sound scenario.
rca of the issue: Fix verified working. Original bug: kubernetes ingress rewrites the Host header so Twilio signature validation failed (Twilio signs URL using foreman.drunderhood.com, server saw internal cluster host). Old code returned EMPTY_XML <Response></Response> on signature failure, causing dead air = 'fax sound' for callers. Fix: (a) on signature failure, log warning and STILL return full GREETING_XML, (b) build action/transcribeCallback URLs from PUBLIC_BASE_URL env (defaults to https://foreman.drunderhood.com), (c) add public_base URL as a third signature candidate in _verify_twilio. All three behaviors confirmed by tests.
